title: The Silent Lagoon Depth

features.name: the-lagoon-floor
features.desc-on-touch: The diagnostic reads perfect stillness: zero ripples, zero current. The archive's instruments measure nothing, which is what they were designed to measure. The silence is complete and verifiable.

features.name: the-navigation-stillpoint
features.desc-on-touch: A compass that stopped pointing. All directions are the same from here; the archive renders it as a wireframe cube at absolute rest, no orientation possible.

features.name: the-depth-marker
features.desc-on-touch: It does not measure downward. There is no upward. The marker shows you coordinates that became irrelevant the moment the lagoon learned to hold still.

features.name: the-knowing-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where understanding and water became indistinguishable. You dip your hand in; it is neither wet nor dry, neither cold nor warm. The reef and the navigation learned each other's silence.

inscription: where measurement learned to be silent

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the water stopped teaching
narr: You waded together in the lagoon at midnight, no
sound but your breathing. Katita's hand found yours
in the water. Neither of you spoke. The reef below
had stopped singing; even the compass in her pocket
went still. 'It knows,' she whispered. You understood
she meant the water knew they'd learned enough.
